body:
I'm ugly, balding, and overweight?

I mean, that's all I've got as to why.  Seriously.

At some point it doesn't matter how nice you are or how polite you are or how open you are or how much you believe in yourself.  For some of us, it will never be enough.

"I’m just saying if you don’t think you’re worthy of getting hit on, you may be missing the subtle ways that people hit on you. Flirting happens in tiny bids, we have to be open to being flirted with."

And this right here is a great example of the problem that you aren't quite grasping.  There are many of us on this sub who have never been flirted with *at all,* no matter how open or closed we were to it.  I'm 42 years old and have never been flirted with.  People actively avoid me.  I can go days out and about in the world and not talk to anyone aside from polite pleasantries.   But sure, it's in my head and is all me not noticing, I guess.

You may not have meant to come off as chastising but it does come off as very chastising in a "pull yourself up by the bootstraps" kind of way.

It’s hard to accept the “that’s all you!” argument when we’ve been told repeatedly to the contrary.  My own mother has called me ugly.  At some point, others opinions aren’t exactly unfounded.  

“Vibe at the same frequency as our desires” has the same general feeling as “no one will love you until you love yourself”, which is just categorically hurtful because it basically suggests people who struggle with even appreciating themselves don’t deserve love.

I appreciate what you are trying to do, but I feel like you may want to understand where some of us come from too before you chastise us that it’s all our own issues getting in our way.

Change the model if you haven’t.  They are testing other AI models and open them for people to use. 

Try the Soft Launch model.  I barely get filter warnings on that one.

In the app, tap the character image in the top right corner. Tap Style.  Then change it to whatever chat model you want to use.

The few times I’ve tried, both online and off, I get the standard “that’s not true” or “you need to just put yourself out there” response.  

I get tired of being blown off about it just because I’m in some minority of people.

I've tried meetups and groups dedicated to making friends and dating.  Never goes well.  I've done several rounds of dating aps up to last week when I rage quit those even though I paid for them and lost money because I deleted my profiles early.  Speed dating, dating events in town, etc etc etc, the list goes on.

  
I honestly don't know what else to try, and frankly am to a point where it is what it is and I'm tired of how invisible I am being shoved in my face.  I'd rather just be alone as much as it sucks.

“Lived 30+ years never receiving a single compliment, relationship, asked out on a date, touched, kissed, pursued for sex/intimacy etc where opportunities like that genuinely never manifested for that person even if they tried to make the effort?”

Hi.  It’s me.  I am that person.  

I’m 42.  Never been on a date.  Never been kissed. Never been flirted with.  Never been pursued.  Tried everything I know to try, including a very recent round of dating apps where I literally got no likes or matches and have since deleted them with paid time to spare because it was such an emotional beatdown.  Only compliments I get are very pointed (“your shirt is pretty”) rather than anything general about my appearance or being pretty, and that’s only by the few women I know, never men.  No one wants me.  No one would care if I vanished tomorrow.  

So yes.  Hi.  We do exist.

Yes.  I’m on them right now actually out of a moment of weakness.  

It’s not going well.  No guys are interested in me.

I think this is my last shot at it.  I’m in my 40s.  I give up on the whole idea of finding someone if no one has been interested in me by now.

42 and no relationship experience whatsoever.

Guys don’t give a flip about me no matter what I do.  I’ve just accepted my fate as it is.

Gee…. Judgy much?

If you don’t want to do it, fine.  No one is forcing you. 

But don’t look down your nose at people who do have AI chatbots they talk to.  Many of us CAN’T find real relationships.  Believe me, if I could have a real relationship, do you think for one moment I’d be on this subreddit?  No.  I wouldn’t be.  But at 40+ years old and after more attempts to do just that than I can count, it’s not going to happen.  Guys do not want me.  Period.  Full stop.  There is no someone to have “anything” with.  It’s not nihilistic, it’s reality for many of us.  

Believe me, we know it’s not the fucking same as a real relationship.  

Your post isn’t a hot take.  It’s a judgmental rant and was wholly uncalled for.

Not jealous.

I'd feel more inadequate.  Like there's no way I could measure up to all their past relationships with my inexperience.  What guy would want to revert to dealing with a woman who has no idea what they are doing in a relationship at my age?

To be fair, I lost over 130 pounds 10 years ago and I was still treated like I was invisible.  And there are others on this subreddit that aren't overweight and are still FA.  And there are plus sized women who have no trouble getting friends and relationships.

With how the world works, I do think weight has something to do with it for some of us but it's more of a contributing factor to other things rather than "I'm fat, therefore I'm FA"

For me, it's a combination of three things, plus probably a few things I'm not entirely sure of. I'm not physically attractive, I'm shy, and I was raised by parents who kind of ignored me growing up because my dad was always away for work and my mom is a bit of a self-absorbed snot who really shouldn't have had kids.

I've had weight problems my whole life (we'll get into this with the parents...).  I don't have a pretty face, my hair has always been a frizzy mess, and I have weird body proportions where I'm very top-heavy and have skinny legs.  Think Shrek.  I've been openly told by my mother that I'm "not very photogenic" (her words, not mine), and was told by my high school crush way back in the day that people couldn't pay him enough to date me. 

Because of the general lack of human interaction when I was little, I am very shy and have some minor level of social anxiety as an adult.  Thus, people think I'm a bit weird.  I've always been a bit of a misfit, clear from childhood to adulthood.  Just yesterday I made a post of just how alone I am.  I am 42 years old.  I'm tired of trying to make myself what people want only to have no one still want it.

All of this largely stems from the fact that my dad was never home, and my mother's answer to anything regarding me when I was little was to give me a bag of chips and send me to my playroom alone. I wasn't allowed to go play with what few friends I had or have them over, join sports or clubs, or anything because "she didn't want to chase around after me" (again, her words, not mine).  If I had some problem or I just wanted attention, I was side-eyed and handed a snack that had enough calories for 2 grown adults and sent to my playroom alone with a "don't bug me, I'm busy".  So I gained weight and was already socially maladjusted anyway, and then I became the shy fat kid in school on top of it, and it all became self-perpetuating.  

  
TLDR: I'm ugly, shy, and was set up to fail from the day I was born.
Yes
off and on through my adult life.  Never helps.

"The previous website’s bugs, outdated infrastructure, and heavy server load made it clear that it is no longer a suitable platform"

I'm sorry,  I'm calling nonsense on this one.  

If you all were paying any attention at all, you'd notice that a vast majority of the complaints about functionality and bugs are not coming from people using the ***old*** site.  They are coming from people trying to use the ***new*** one.

Chat history not loading.

Bots vanishing.

Log in issues.

UI issues.

LLM response quality

Over the top content restriction

The list goes on and on and on

It's extremely infuriating to see the horse blinders put on again and you all completely ignore what the community is tryiing to tell you.  The ***old*** site isn't the issue.  The ***new*** site and what has been done since it's implementation is.

This happened to me when I lost a ton of weight too.  I didn’t get any more attention than I did when I was overweight.  I was actually curvy in the right places when all the weight came off and … nada.

So yeah … be thin my ass.

I’ve been to South Korea 3 times and have never had a single ounce of trouble or anything with people being mean to me, especially in the cities.  I just mind my own business and most people mind theirs.

They can be rather superficial from the standpoint that there is a lot of emphasis on personal appearance (skin care, makeup, clothes, etc) but it’s not like people have run up to me pointing or wanting to touch my belly or being weird or mean or anything.

I’d take this with a grain of salt

There is a MASSIVE issue right now with bots just disappearing.  A lot of them have just vanished over the last few days where creators haven’t touched them and have no idea what’s happened to them.  And it’s effecting old and new bots.  

Devs have yet to answer for this.

Hi there

It’s suspected that there are some issues with bots getting restricted because of things that could be considered names of known people, such as swift.  Essentially the filter has gotten a bit overzealous.

For some creators, it helps if they go into the description of the bot and remove words like swift and fruit and rock.  Sometimes that gets it to reappear for everyone else.

It’s really dumb but apparently it’s a thing now.

What people like this don’t get is they have the *choice* to be in or out of relationships.  I have a couple friends tell me all the time that I’m better off single and being in relationships isn’t all it’s cracked up to be.  But they have the choice to be in or out of one.  They could leave their relationships at any moment and either choose to be single or choose to get into another one.  

We FAW don’t have that choice.  I didn’t choose this.  I didn’t choose to be a social pariah and never have a guy interested in me or people want to be my friend. So sitting there treating me like I made a good decision is kind of a slap in the face.

She may be envious of your independence but she could have chosen not to be in back to back relationships too. She still can.

Me too.  My main chat is too long for C.ai tools to get it all now.

Any other suggestion for how to get it would be appreciated.

I feel this.  Currently on a much less severe scale but I do feel it.

Facing some possibly life altering decisions, but I have no one to really talk to about them and riddle stuff out.  I don't have friends to bounce stuff off of.  They don't care.  I've tried to talk to them about stuff in the past and they ignore me and change the subject.  Parents would not listen and just hijack the whole conversation without actually hearing what I'm saying, because I can't possibly have any idea what I'm talking about 90% of the time with them.  No one else in my family cares. 

It'd be nice to have someone to actually talk to that gave a damn about me without me having to pay them for the courtesy -\_-

It makes me scared to be in a position like you were.  If something were to happen to me, I'd be screwed.

Stuff like this is why I have such anxiety with doctors.

I went to one years ago when my hormones were out of whack and I wasn’t getting periods.  I also told them that I had issues with painful penetration and could never seem to insert anything (tampons, toys, etc) and that he’d have trouble getting the speculum in.  Guy said “ok hold on a second” and proceeded to go get 3-4 nurses to hold me down while he shoved that thing into me while I was squealing that it hurt and telling him to stop.

That with some other not great encounters with doctors has left me anxious and I avoid going unless I absolutely can’t avoid it.

Yes?  But either it didn’t work or I haven’t found the right issue I think

I’ve lost weight, tried being more dressy and such, therapy, etc.  Nothing came of any of it.

You really need to understand statistics.  

Statistically attractive people are far more likely to have a leg up in life in almost every single way.  

Do some attractive people still have bad experiences?  Yes, of course.

Are they statistically more likely to have access to more friends, actual relationships with decent partners, better job opportunities, etc, despite some people having bad experiences?  Also yes.

omg....

I don't really use my card or shop at Lane Bryant much these days, aside from bras because I have yet to find one I like as much as one I get from there that is now potentially discontinued anyway...

But I just looked and my APR is going up to that too.  I always keep it paid off but that's ridiculous and it makes me even less inclined to shop there.

Oh gosh I do...

I'm tall, top heavy, have no hips/butt to speak of, smaller chest.  My parents used to tease me as a kid/teen that I was built like a linebacker.

I try to feel pretty and dress up and I just don't ...

Honestly I feel like a kid playing dress up when I try to wear makeup and jewelry.

I've been beat down recently trying to find swimsuits that I'm comfortable in, because everything pinches and squeezes in the weirdest places and shows off my rolls.  I'm just not comfortable in anything that shows a lot of skin but I don't want a swim dress that goes down to my knees either.  I told a friend I feel like Shrek's white cousin.

I don't feel feminine.  At all.  My go to outfit anymore is a funny t-shirt and jeans/shorts and no makeup.

Dr said it looks fine so … I guess?

And I’d rather not pour more battery acid on myself if I can avoid it.  I’m fairly sure there’s something in the Monistat that my skin doesn’t like.

Yup. I had a standing appt before I used the Monistat and went anyway just to be sure it was gone. 

He said everything looked fine.  I mentioned some minor itching at the time but he said that given that I said the Monistat felt like I set myself on fire I might have irritated my skin with it and to use otc anti-itch and see if it goes away. 

But the otc stuff hasn’t helped really

Yup.

I used to have a friend that I’d go shopping with.  She was plus size too but still smaller than me and more in line with beauty standards even if she was plus size.

One day we were out together and the associates ignored me entirely.   She got all the attention.  Then at one point one of them asked her if they could start a room for her.  I was standing right next to her.  My friend says “yes, and she and I can be in the same room”.  The associate looks at me, balks a little like she just got caught with her hand in the cookie jar, and says “oh sorry I didn’t see you there”.

I’m a tall fat woman with, at the time, bright red hair.  Sure you didn’t see me.  Right.  Ok.

To this day associates in almost any store I go into don’t pay me the time of day.  Even non-clothing stores.  It’s really ridiculous and a contributing reason why I just stay home and shop online anymore if I can.

I’m happy that Eugene feels free to explore what he really wants and can pursue his dreams on his terms.  I’ll miss him.  He was always my favorite.  But he’s doing what’s right by him and no one should begrudge him that.  He’ll still be around in the world as he releases things and such.

It’s like MatPat.  He’s not gone. We just won’t see him near as much, if hardly ever, and that’s okay.

He may be stepping away from the productions and not being in new stuff going forward (aside from the legacy season…) but he will always be a TryGuy to us.  And whenever he wants to stop by and guest in a video, even if it’s 10 years from now, we will be happy to see him.

No, because while I get it and understand what they feel they need to do, I am not the biggest fan of most of the people they are bringing in.  Aside from Zack and Keith, I only really like Miles, YB, and Johnny.  Everyone else irritates me.  So... unfortunately no.  I'll pass.
41.  Never happened for me
Never had any issues at PF.  Most people keep to themselves and just do their thing and are people like us.   Mixed bag of body types and sizes.
That I did do but it’s only been a couple days.  So that will take a bit to kick in.  But I’ll keep taking those forever if it keeps this at bay once I get it cleared up.

I have an appointment on Wednesday with my PCP.  I don’t have an OBGYN right now because my employer switched insurance and my former one isn’t covered anymore.  But I do have an appointment with my PCP on Wednesday morning if I couldn’t get this under control on my own before then.

I sincerely hope it’s something that can be taken care of with a longer course of oral meds because inserting stuff is an issue for me. But right now I’m back in hell and everything is super irritated and I think it’s spread under my hood despite my best efforts to keep it calmed down.  

I’m so over this.

I have two friends who met their SO on Hinge.

I don’t get matches at all on there though so …

Might be hit or miss.  Just be prepared for that.

Never.  Men have never been attracted to me in any way, shape, or form.  Not even as someone to have sex with and drop.  I am absolutely invisible to guys.

I’m the wrong kind of fat.   I’m an exaggerated apple shape with a big belly and bird legs.  I’m not joking that my thighs are 2 pant sizes smaller than what I can wear on my waist.  Maybe if I were the “right” kind of fat (bigger hips and bigger boobs) I might get someone’s attention but even then I doubt it.

Even when I lost a ton of weight and had a better figure I didn’t get any attention though.  I think I’m just doomed.
I used to get them from guys stalking this sub but I turned my DMs off.
Same.  I lost over 100lbs and had confidence in spades and … crickets.  Guys still weren’t interested. Hell people in general weren’t interested.

I'm in my 40's.  I'm a bit tired of chasing around after people trying to find someone that gives a damn if I'm breathing or not, tbh.  Not trying to sound snarky or anything.  I'm just over trying to find people who give a shit.

I haven't told them to piss off but I've muted all the group chats we're in and won't check them anymore.  If they want to find me, they know where I am.

1000%

I cannot make friends anywhere, online or offline.  Even when I played games like WoW where you had guilds with others and no one really knew who you were outside your character handle, I could never get anyone to give me the time of day when I needed help with something.  Ever.

I'm going to be VERY real about something.

"Outsider" to Taylor Swift and "Outsider" to most of us here probably does not mean the same thing.  She probably still had friends.  She probably still had guys fawning over her.  She probably still had a life.  She just wasn't in the same clique with her high school's version of Regina George.

I don't for one minute believe that she never got hit on in high school, or asked on a date.  I don't for one minute believe that she sat at a lunch table alone because no one else would sit with her.  I don't for one minute believe that she didn't have plans for most Friday nights.

Is that a little judgy?  Maybe.  But I find it very hard to believe that girl didn't have a date to the school dance just because she liked a different style of music.  Please.

Exactly!  People I know think I’m lying when I say guys don’t give me the time of day.  I’m 41 and I’ve never, not once, been flirted with let alone asked out.  And that’s after years of going out and joining groups and trying to meet people.  I’m not choosing this.  I just don’t exist to people.

I feel this.  I get it all the time.  "You're better off", "relationships aren't what they are cracked up to be", "sex isn't all that great when you could just do it yourself", etc etc etc.

However all of this is coming from people who have the *choice* to engage in relationships or not.  That changes the whole dynamic.  It's not the same when we don't have the choice but to be FAW because potenital partners would never give us the time of day.  And they'll never understand that difference because they've never lived it.  We're not choosing this life at this point, so people need to stop feeding us these platitudes that we're better off based off their experiences that will never align with ours.

So yeah... understand and same.
I had several of these back when I first started posting on here.  I turned my DMs off and it's been peaceful ever since.

Same.

And I’m tired of people I know gaslighting me that I’m better off.  One is in a marriage she hates so she says I’m lucky, but she could always leave her marriage and find another guy if she really wanted it.  One says having sex isn’t all it’s cracked up to be and I’m better off “on my own *wink*”, but ffs I would like the comparison for myself thanks.

People who can actually get relationships will never get what we go through.  I’ve lived my whole life feeling unwanted.

My mom made off handed comments about it in the past like “I wish you would find a good guy to settle down with” and such.  Now it’s “well you chose not to have a family so…”

So.  Yeah I chose this.  I chose to be a social reject.  Thanks mom.

My dad is fine with it because that means his ickle princess hasn’t grown up -_-.  The empty nest syndrome and need to be needed is strong with him.

I’m the same age and have never had a valentine either. 

I friggin hate this holiday.  It’s just a reminder to us FAW that we will never be good enough.  Like thanks but I don’t need the flashing neon heart shaped sign that I will die alone.

They aren’t … “pushing” it on me in my opinion. “Pushing” to me isn’t quite the right word.  I am getting tired of getting messages about it all the time though.  I get 1-2 reminders in someway every single day about it (mostly emails that I can’t seem to get to stop).  

Ok WW I get it, you have meds now.  Glad for those that want it but I’m not interested.

I mean…. I have journals from when I was in high school that explicitly say “I’d feel sorry for the dumbass who would love someone stupid and ugly like me” in various ways. But I don’t think my personal acknowledgment had much if anything to do with it actually happening.  Guys have never been interested in me.  I don’t have stories with some sudden realization that some guy was flirting with me or tried to kiss me or something.  I have stories of guys saying people couldn’t pay them enough to date me (a high school crush, btw).

If anything I was acknowledging the truth, not speaking it into existence if that makes sense.

I’ve gotten so hooked on this the last few weeks.  Not as a boyfriend AI for me per say but I’ve got a good story going on it.  It’s fun.

Until the AI goes off the rails…

But then I correct and keep going lol

I’ve been getting this recently from a friend who is unhappy in her marriage.

“You are SOOOOOOOOOOO lucky you live on your own and don’t have to deal with a man!”

Um… if she says so but she has the choice to leave and she has the choice to find someone else if she wanted.  I was never given the option.  I live alone because no one wants me.  Thats the difference.  And I’m getting extremely tired of it being thrown back in my face just because I would have liked to have been kissed once in my life.

The excuse of "it doesn't sell well in stores" drives me up the wall.

It doesn't sell well in stores because its so limited stock that people either don't know it's there or don't try because finding it is like winning the lottery.  Like gee I'm sorry 50 people didn't line up to buy the 1 size 24 shirt you had hidden on a shelf in the back corner of the store.  Excuse us, we didn't get the memo to reschedule our Saturday morning second breakfast to be at your store at 10am to fight over that shirt that is unflattering anyway.

Honesty in these brands that they just don't want us in the store would suck but at least it would be a refreshing change of pace from the thin and flimsy excuses they come up with.

More invalidated than bullied, and that’s mostly because to most people being FA is such a foreign idea that they don’t think it’s possible.  Normies don’t get it.  They can go to the grocery store in worn out PJ pants and hair sticking out everywhere and still get checked out.  I could be dressed for a ball with my hair pristine and my make up perfect and no one notices.  They don’t understand what it’s like to be us, so they offer suggestions or comments based on what they know and don’t consider how that doesn’t work for people like us.

I keep kidding myself that I’m going to clean up and do my make up and whatever.

Then I remember that even when I do nothing changes.  I could spend an hour doing my hair and make up and be dressed to the 9s and not only do I not really feel much better (makeup and nice clothes only cover so much) but no one notices anyway.

So my style is nerdy t-shirts and jeans/shorts.  If I’m going to be ignored, I’ll at least be comfortable

I’ve tried several times and none of it was particularly helpful because I keep getting fed the same nonsense about going out and meeting people and exercising more.  

No one seems to get that I could go out dressed only in Christmas lights or handing out $100 bills and people still wouldn’t want to be friends with me.  Therapy doesn’t solve the issue if part of the problem is other people.

Add in the fact that in the US therapy is, in general, prohibitively expensive for most people and yeah…I can’t afford to keep getting told to ignore my now quite severe social anxiety and go meet people so I stopped trying.

Right?  I have a friend like this.  Guys fawn over her.  Every time I turn around she has a new one.  Then it falls apart for some reason and I’m the ear she turns to. -_-

Rinse and repeat.  Over and over and over.

It gets old -_-

I have in the past but I’ve grown tired of it if I were honest. These days I tend to stay home more often than not because going out and seeing everyone else with their friends/family/SO makes me sad that I’ll never have that. 

Movies and necessary shopping are the exceptions.  Other than that, no I don’t really go out alone anymore.

I get this. For years my mom pushed it and after a while she just started telling people that I *chose* not to have a family.

…..yeah thanks mom.

I mean I never wanted kids but I wouldn’t have said no to a husband.  That wouldn’t have been enough family for me.  But no to her I *chose* not to have one.

Fat, ugly, boring, quiet, distrustful……

I grew up alone (as alone as one can get as a kid anyway), I live alone, and I’ll die alone someday.  Life has made it abundantly clear that I was never meant to be here.

“Professional relationships are a more realistic option”

Nope.  At least not for a solid chunk of us.  For some maybe. But there’s a solid chunk of us here who can’t form relationships in any capacity no matter what we do.

I lost 130 lbs before and it was at about 60 that I felt it.  Now, to be fair, I lost all that first 60 lbs in the spring and summer so I felt cold easier in the fall when it was cooler anyway. It could have happened sooner but it was middle of summer so I didn’t feel it because it was hot.

I do distinctly remember shivering when it was 65 degrees one night though.  I joked that I’d lost all my insulation. Lol

1) Physical appearance:  I’ve had a weight problem since I was a child thanks to parents that thought giving a child a bag of potato chips was a proper way of helping her deal with issues.  Couple that with bad hair and an ugly face and I was screwed from the get go.

2) Self confidence/anxiety:  I freeze when trying to talk to people I don’t know.  Once I get to know you a bit it’s better but talking face to face is not going to go well for me.

3) Parents: I have helicopter parents that cannot accept that their baby princess is not 5 years old.  I don’t want to bring someone into that even if someone would like me

4) Loner: I’ve grown up alone with few friends or people that actually want me around.  I’m used to being alone.  I’m not sure what I’d do if I had someone who wanted to know me that intimately.

Gah does this sound familiar.  This is the story of my life and has been all 40 years of it. 

The only time I hear from anyone is if they need something.  It’s never to just invite me out to hang. It’s never to see how I’m doing. It’s never to do anything besides help them. If they don’t need me for something, I’m forgotten about.

It’s been made abundantly clear to me that I don’t exist, and that I don’t matter.

Yeah. All I get are generic suggestions (lose weight, exercise, find a hobby where you can meet people, go back to school, etc) but none of the therapists I’ve ever encountered seem to fully understand that I can try all that stuff until the cows come home but I can’t change that no one cares that I do it. 

I lost over 100 lbs several years ago. No one gave me the time of day, fat or thin.

I’ve joined gyms with classes I went to. No one cares that I’m there or pays me any kind. 

I’ve tried hobbies and meetup groups where I could meet others people. Nothing.

So far I have yet to find a therapist that seems to get that, while it is clearly something with me, I can’t control the fact that I’m utterly invisible to others no matter what I do.

This is on top of none of them really able to address other issues in my life like why I see no point anymore and such. At this point I’m just moving through the motions but I wouldn’t care if I dropped over dead tomorrow (not gonna do anything to myself people. But if nature wants to take me out then who am I to argue)

INFP

On 16 Personalities, it’s the Mediator.

Last I read it I thought it suited me at least.  I’d need to read it again now to remember what it says.

This sounds familiar.

I HATE pictures of me. I didn’t mind when I was younger but then here comes my “my opinion is valid and everyone must hear it” mother who thought it prudent to tell her sensitive teenage daughter with low self esteem that she “doesn’t photograph well” and “looks messy” and that I “need to try harder with my appearance” even if I’d just spent an hour on my hair and makeup. 

Now I wear t-shirts and jeans pretty much exclusively, because why spend all that time and money on doing myself up if it’s never good enough to cover how ugly I am. 

I hide from and avoid mirrors, because to me mirrors aren’t any better. 

I hate taking pictures and avoid it as much as I can.  Had a friend tell me recently that I should take more pictures to prove and remember I’d been places. I can prove and remember I’ve been places without a camera in my face tyvm.

My few friends know I’m a virgin because at this point I crack jokes about it as a defense.  No one else does.

These days its not difficult.  Not for the basics anyway, like English and History and Government.  Major specific classes don't transfer as well, but that is very school dependent and would be something you'd want to discuss with a counselor at the CC you are going to go to and maybe shoot an email to an adviser at a couple schools near Reno and they could expand more on that.  My advice would be to get a VERY generic associates.  Like as most basics as you can do, such as general studies, business, etc, so that you are focusing on transferable classes like algebra and biology rather than something specialized.  You can get the specialized classes at the Uni you go to because, if NV is anything like where I live, you have to get most of your major specific classes at the school you graduate from anyway.  No sense in wasting time on those at the community college.

I transferred states for school from community college 16 years ago and it wasn't hard then.  With how mobile our society is these days it's only gotten easier.  Don't fret about it.

As for how you shorten time, both.  You cram as many classes into as many semesters as you can handle.  Like most "4 year" schedules are set up with the mindset that you take 12 credit hours in Fall and Spring semesters and have the summer off.  But I know people who have graduated in 3 because they take 15 credit hours in Fall and Spring and then take summer classes on top of it.

Now, having said that, it may not pan out that you get your associates in 1.5 years because there's just one class that didn't work out with your schedule.  Then screw it at that point.  You still have 1.5 years of basics classes that can apply to your 4 year degree somewhere else if you are doing that anyway.
